rationale: A is substantially more useful for a careful decision-maker because it compares all live options explicitly, quantifies expected outcomes and uncertainty, identifies failure modes, and gives a concrete execution plan plus contingency if timing is tight. B gives a sensible recommendation and decent practical guidance, but it is lighter on discriminating evidence, does not quantify tradeoffs, and handles uncertainty mostly qualitatively. A better supports an actual launch decision rather than just arguing for a preferred sequence.
